"""Opt-in training CUDA Graph experiment, allocated GPU only."""
import argparse
import gc
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import time
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch.utils.checkpoint
from benchmarks.runners.bench import bench_time
from benchmarks.runners.measurement import benchmark_source_hash, compile_for_benchmark, observe_execution
from benchmarks.runners.mpnn_attribution import model_for
from benchmarks.runners.mpnn_training import logits_for, make_inputs, param_audit
from miniworld_engine.autotune import cache

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--policy',choices=['pytorch','all_compute','current'],required=True)
p.add_argument('--mode',choices=['off','on'],required=True)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
a=p.parse_args()
assert not a.out.exists()
a.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
assert 'A6000' in torch.cuda.get_device_name()
assert not torch.is_autocast_enabled('cuda')
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=True
source=benchmark_source_hash()
record=dict(status='running',policy=a.policy,mode=a.mode,source_hash=source,runner_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),uuid=str(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).uuid),batch=8,length=8192,neighbors=48,width=128,dropout=.25,precision='native_bf16_fp32_layernorm',autocast=False,checkpoint=False,compile_requested=True,graph_scope='forward+loss+backward' if a.mode=='on' else 'disabled',optimizer='same eager AdamW in both modes',timing_scope='fresh-gradient forward+loss+backward+eager AdamW; resident static inputs; input transfer excluded')
def save():
    a.out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ['status','policy','mode','phase'] if k in record}),flush=True)
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):
    raise AssertionError('checkpoint API not allowed')
torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint=forbidden
cache.clear_cache_misses()
save()
try:
    model,resolved=model_for(a.policy,.25)
    record['parameter_counts']=param_audit(model)
    record['resolved_policy']=resolved
    inputs=make_inputs(8,8192)
    params=list(model.parameters())
    optimizer=torch.optim.AdamW(params,lr=1e-4)
    def loss_fn():
        logits=logits_for(model,inputs)
        assert logits.dtype==torch.bfloat16
        return F.cross_entropy(logits.float(),inputs[1])
    forward=compile_for_benchmark(loss_fn,fullgraph=True)
    def forward_backward():
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        loss=forward()
        loss.backward()
        return loss.detach()
    side=torch.cuda.current_stream() if a.mode=='off' else torch.cuda.Stream()
    side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
    record['phase']='compile_warmup';save()
    with torch.cuda.stream(side),observe_execution() as evidence:
        for _ in range(2):
            loss=forward_backward()
    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    assert evidence.compiled
    record['compile_observed']=evidence.compiled
    record['compile_scopes']=sorted(evidence.scopes)
    param_audit(model,True)
    if a.mode=='on':
        record['phase']='capture';save()
        # Same weights and seeded dropout for the compiled, uncaptured reference.
        torch.manual_seed(20260920)
        with torch.cuda.stream(side):
            reference_loss=forward_backward()
        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        expected_loss=float(reference_loss.detach())
        expected_grad=torch.cat([x.grad.detach().flatten().cpu().double() for x in params])
        del loss,reference_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        gc.collect();torch.cuda.empty_cache();torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
        graph=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
        start=time.monotonic()
        with torch.cuda.graph(graph,stream=side):
            graph_loss=forward_backward()
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        record['capture_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
        record['capture_peak_allocated_gib']=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()/2**30
        record['capture_peak_reserved_gib']=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved()/2**30
        static_grad=tuple(x.grad for x in params)
        assert all(x is not None for x in static_grad)
        def snapshot(seed=None):
            if seed is not None:
                torch.manual_seed(seed)
            graph.replay();torch.cuda.synchronize()
            return float(graph_loss.detach()),torch.cat([x.grad.detach().flatten().cpu().double() for x in params])
        value,grad=snapshot(20260920)
        relative=float((grad-expected_grad).norm()/expected_grad.norm().clamp_min(1e-30))
        record['graph_vs_compiled']={'loss_off':expected_loss,'loss_on':value,'gradient_relative_l2':relative}
        save()
        assert abs(value-expected_loss)<1e-5 and relative<.002,record['graph_vs_compiled']
        # A fresh replay must overwrite gradients, advance dropout, and honor seed reset.
        value2,grad2=snapshot()
        value3,grad3=snapshot(20260920)
        repeat=float((grad3-grad).norm()/grad.norm().clamp_min(1e-30))
        dropout_difference=float((grad2-grad).norm()/grad.norm().clamp_min(1e-30))
        assert abs(value3-value)<1e-5 and repeat<.002,(value3,value,repeat)
        assert dropout_difference>1e-4,dropout_difference
        # Resident input buffers remain writable between graph replays.
        old_labels=inputs[1].clone()
        inputs[1].copy_((old_labels+1)%21)
        changed_value,_=snapshot(20260920)
        assert abs(changed_value-value)>1e-5,(changed_value,value)
        inputs[1].copy_(old_labels)
        del old_labels,expected_grad,grad,grad2,grad3
        record['replay_validation']=dict(reseed_gradient_relative_l2=repeat,successive_dropout_gradient_difference=dropout_difference,loss_before=value,loss_next=value2,loss_reseed=value3,loss_changed_labels=changed_value,static_input_update_observed=True,gradient_overwrite_verified=True)
        def step():
            graph.replay()
            optimizer.step()
            return graph_loss
    else:
        def step():
            loss=forward_backward()
            optimizer.step()
            return loss.detach()
    record['phase']='optimizer_warmup';save()
    torch.manual_seed(20260921)  # Align optimizer/timing dropout after mode-specific validation.
    for _ in range(2):
        result=step();torch.cuda.synchronize()
        assert torch.isfinite(result)
        param_audit(model,True)
    assert all(s['exp_avg'].dtype==p.dtype==s['exp_avg_sq'].dtype for p,s in optimizer.state.items())
    before=next(iter(optimizer.state.values()))['step'].item()
    weight_before=[p.detach().cpu().clone() for p in params]
    step();torch.cuda.synchronize()
    assert next(iter(optimizer.state.values()))['step'].item()==before+1
    assert any(not torch.equal(old,p.detach().cpu()) for old,p in zip(weight_before,params))
    del weight_before
    record['optimizer_update_verified']=True
    record['phase']='timing';save()
    samples=[bench_time(step) for _ in range(7)]
    record.update(samples=samples,median_step_ms=statistics.median(x['median_ms'] for x in samples))
    record['phase']='memory_validation';save()
    memories=[]
    for _ in range(5):
        if a.mode=='off':
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        gc.collect();torch.cuda.empty_cache();torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
        result=step();torch.cuda.synchronize()
        param_audit(model,True)
        assert torch.isfinite(result)
        if a.mode=='on':
            assert all(p.grad is g for p,g in zip(params,static_grad))
        free,total=torch.cuda.mem_get_info()
        memories.append(dict(loss=float(result.detach()),allocated_gib=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()/2**30,reserved_gib=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved()/2**30,device_used_after_step_gib=(total-free)/2**30))
    assert not cache.cache_misses(),cache.cache_misses()
    assert benchmark_source_hash()==source
    record.update(status='ok',phase='done',memory=memories,replay_phase_allocator_peak_gib=max(x['allocated_gib'] for x in memories),peak_allocated_including_capture_gib=max(record.get('capture_peak_allocated_gib',0),max(x['allocated_gib'] for x in memories)),peak_reserved_gib=max(x['reserved_gib'] for x in memories),cache_misses=[],graph_replay_observed=a.mode=='on')
    save()
except Exception as exc:
    record.update(status='oom' if isinstance(exc,torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError) else 'error',error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
    save()
    raise

decision.reason: At this fixed B8/L8192 workload, observed whole-step reductions are only 0.05-0.32%; no material speed benefit is established. Graph replay is functional and passes the recorded training checks.
decision.interpretation: Small graph gains suggest host dispatch is not the dominant whole-step cost at this size. This is an inference for the measured workload; smaller shapes and captured-optimizer variants were not tested.
